_schema: Structural world-model beliefs the Specialist may lean on. confidence in [0,1]. Retire beliefs that prove wrong rather than letting them rot.

beliefs.statement: Polymarket prices are an efficient prior; deviating from them requires a concrete, stateable mechanism, not just a narrative.
Crowds over-react to vivid recent news; mean-reversion toward base rates is a recurring (but not universal) edge.
Most 'surprise' edges in prediction markets come from misreading the resolution criteria, not from superior world-knowledge.
